bigIdea: Scanning every pallet at the dock will end the Friday recounts by September.

beats.name: Now
beats.claim: Friday recounts take four hours because pallets are logged by hand.

beats.name: North Star
beats.claim: Every pallet scanned at the dock means the count is right before it reaches a shelf.

beats.name: Phases
beats.claim: Dock 1 goes live in June and the other three docks by August.

beats.name: Risks
beats.claim: Scanners fail in the freezer, so cold-room pallets keep paper tags until fall.

beats.name: Measures
beats.claim: We will know it worked when Friday recounts stop.
